observed.error: No migration operation was found for the selected Platform module.

rootCause: The public Reference lifecycle correctly discovers education/referenceFixture, but passes that current logical name unchanged to the generic historical migration runner. Immutable V93/V94/U93/U94 packs are contract-owned under refDB, so no operation can be resolved.
requiredFix: Derive the single historical pack identity from the Reference Fixture contract, create a disposable profile projection for the nested migration call, preserve the original physical database/schema/credentials, and use the same projection for dry-run and apply.
